meaning: 关心/在乎员工的感受与福祉
usageNote: 动词短语，care about = 在乎某人，比care for更偏情感上的重视，老板说这个感觉特别暖！

examples.en: Great companies care about their workers and provide good benefits.
examples.zh: 优秀的公司关心员工，并提供良好的福利。

examples.en: Our manager really cares about their workers — she always checks in on us.
examples.zh: 我们经理真的很在乎员工——她总是关心我们的状态。
